title: Giants committed to helping quarterback J.J. McCarthy 'do what he does best' in Week 7 start

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants committed to helping quarterback J.J. McCarthy 'do what he does best' in Week 7 start
sources.description: The Giants will be using a third different starting quarterback this season when they travel to Houston to take on the Texans on Sunday afternoon after announcing earlier in the week that J.J. McCarthy earned the start over Jameis Winston.
